biography:
Andrew is a top real estate transactions leader, managing acquisitions, building programs and developing people while creatively solving problems and inventing new processes. Andrew is an innovator, collaborator, and team builder, known for earning trust, leading teams and obsessing over customers.

Andrew has acquired over 120 mainly build-to-suit properties in 38 US states and 5 countries including US, Canada, Brazil, Mexico and Australia, leading teams of legal, design, finance and pre-construction professionals to deal completion, reporting to SVPs and the C-Suite providing clear, concise recommendations for strategic real estate portfolio decisions.
